featureDefaultsDiff.note: DLL/PDB-only overlay; it ships no runtime configuration or feature-default file. The untouched Nexus 1.4.1 install remains authoritative for all scripts, interface/configuration, and dialogue-replacement content.

requirements: Build and inspect DLL status check

changes: Ported the released 1.4.1 source to the pinned format-5 CommonLibSSE-NG maintenance branch.
Restricted SKSE metadata and the load-time gate to Skyrim 1.7.104.
Preflighted the four call sites, callable targets, and DialogueMenu vtable target before mutation.
Checked and aborted failed Detours transactions and deferred listener/Papyrus registration until hook success.
Changed fatal CommonLib failures to log, flush, and terminate without a native message box.
Corrected the upstream post-build output-directory creation defect.
